scope: ignore stale Field Collector operations inventory responses after location changes

implementation.request_version: Each inventory request gets a monotonically increasing local version; response and error handlers only update the console when their version remains current.
implementation.network_behavior: No additional request is created, aborted, or retried by the guard.

limits: The race guard is pinned by source contract tests; browser automation did not simulate delayed network responses.
This does not establish live OIDC, database, or external ingress acceptance.
